# detect_smiles_in_mol { #mofography.analyze.detect_smiles_in_mol }

```python
analyze.detect_smiles_in_mol(smiles_molecule, smiles_pattern)
```

Return subgraph-isomorphism maps from a SMILES pattern into a SMILES molecule graph.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name            | Type   | Description                                             | Default    |
|-----------------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| smiles_molecule |        | The SMILES string of the molecule you want to search in | _required_ |
| smiles_pattern  |        | The SMILES pattern you want to search for               | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                                                                            |
|--------|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        |        | A list of dictionaries. Each dictionary contains the mapping of the nodes in the pattern to the nodes in the molecule. |
